name: app-green-gradient-profile-card-light-and-dark-variants
title: Green Gradient Profile Cards
whatItIs: Two profile card variants: a white card with a green gradient banner, avatar, follow button, three stats and a black-to-grey Get in Touch bar, and a full-bleed green gradient card with outlined buttons and a white CTA.
whatItMeans: The mesh green gradient adds lush, organic colour to a simple card, and the pair proves the component's range.
techniques: Mesh gradient as the card's colour source
Inverted CTA (dark on white card, white on gradient card)
Arrow-in-circle inside a wide pill button

vocabulary.definition: A multi-point blend of colours creating organic transitions.
A version of a component with swapped foreground and background.
Three key numbers with icons and labels in a row.
